axfL (with wfL, gfL, spfL) can slide 16.0 mm (-axis -y) until wfL touches wfR; after 9.4 mm it comes out of the motor motfL's output (the drive is lost). Only the friction of the cross fit holds it there. Add a bush or stop so it cannot travel that far.

gfL (on axfL) can slide 16.0 mm (-axis -y) until wfL touches wfR; after 7.0 mm it is out of mesh with igaL and the drive stops. Only the friction of the cross fit holds it. Close the gap with a bush or move a part so it stops the cluster.

spfL (on axfL) can slide 16.0 mm (-axis -y) until wfL touches wfR; after 2.0 mm it is off the line of the chain to sprL (it throws the chain) and the drive stops. Only the friction of the cross fit holds it. Close the gap with a bush or move a part so it stops the cluster.

h8gL (on h8aL) can slide 8.0 mm (+axis +y) until h8gL touches hxL71; after 7.0 mm it is out of mesh with igaL and the drive stops. Nothing holds it there; straight teeth do not push it, but side loads on the wheels can walk it along the axle. Close the gap with a bush or move a part so it stops the cluster.
